من أوسع وأضخم أعمال الحديث النبويﷺ: One of the biggest and most detailed works on the sayings of the Prophet (ﷺ).
تحت إشراف سماحة الشيخ المفتي والمحدث محم: Under the supervision of His Eminence, the Grand Mufti and Hadith scholar Muhammad Taqi Usmani (may Allah preserve him), at Darul Uloom University, Karachi, Pakistan.
عدد الأحاديث المرفوعة 210000 في أكثر من: Number of raised Hadiths: 210,000 in more than 23,000 chapters, and with narrations, reasons, and explanations: 400,000.
عدد الأحاديث المرفوعة21000 شواهدها 23000: The number of hadiths with chains of transmission is 21,000, their supporting evidence is 23,000, and their methods with chains of transmission and texts are 400,000.
الشرح الكامل لجميع الأحاديث المرفوعة زاد: A complete explanation of all Marfū‘ Hadiths, including the text, chains of transmission, and distinctions, presented in a simple and beneficial style, authenticated and verified. This compilation is the work of the enlightened scholars, from which all other services for the Ummah in Hadith studies are derived, God willing.
جمع الأحاديث على أكبر القياسات في أكبر ع: Collection of Hadiths according to the largest classifications from the greatest number of books, with reference to an authenticated Hadith source.
تخريج موحد لجميع الأحاديث تحت موضوع واحد: Unified authentication (Takhreej) of all Hadiths under a single topic, continued across the pages of the large compilation.
Preparation and storage of the database on the computer.
الترتيب للأحاديث المرفوعة المنسوبة إلى ا: Arrangement of the Marfū‘ Hadiths attributed to the Prophet ﷺ without repetition, so that for the first time in the Hadith world, only the narrators and authenticated explanations are presented.
ذكر الحكم على كل حديث من الصحة والضعف وا: Stating the ruling on each Hadith regarding its authenticity, weakness, and hidden defects.
Distribution of the Hadiths across volumes and units.
ترجمة الحديث إلى اللغة الإنجليزية مع الم: Translation of the Hadith into English while maintaining the same Arabic order.
إخراج الشرح بعد عرض حديث النبي صلى الله: Presenting the explanation immediately after displaying the Prophet’s ﷺ Hadith, making understanding and reflection easier.
